document.abstract: A color converter was developed with a view to improving color reproduction in television. Using this converter, an investigation was made into the relation of color TV to memory color; it was found that the memory color depended on the subject, not the viewer. The memory color related to the flesh color of white persons has a dominant wavelength of λd = 585 nm and an excitation purity of Pe = 32.7%.
